replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
From the pictures it seems extremely plain and flat. Adding height, patterns, obstacles, buildings and such to your map can improve it greatly.

Due to the size of the map I also don't think you should have the diamonds you currently do. That can turn the whole match upside down and throw it down a hole.

I am also a little bit worried about gameplay on the map because of the placement of monuments, the size and that there is no void. I am not sure how it will play.

You did go with an interesting design though. I like the shape you went with. You should improve the map because it has potential.

→ Too plain. How could you make it look more appealing?
→ Too flat. Could you improve it with terrain or structures?
→ Blocky. Do you think you could shape the map better?
→ OP items. Are diamond swords with enchants too OP?
→ Anvils. Avicus does not currently want maps with anvils.
